emptyState.title: No jobs to apply to yet
emptyState.description: Collect jobs from LinkedIn first, then come back here to apply automatically.

controls.title: Application Controls
controls.loginInfo: Sign-ins: Sign in to Gmail (for verification codes) and LinkedIn once in Settings → Accounts & email; every run uses those sign-ins.
controls.exportDownloaded: Saved to your Downloads folder as langhirev2-jobs.csv
controls.limitHelp: Leave blank to apply to all {{count}} pending jobs
controls.pauseHint: Want to fix something yourself? Pause first, so the agent doesn't undo your changes.
controls.pausedHint: Paused. The agent stopped after its last action: make your changes in the browser (you can also click Next), then Resume. It re-reads the page and keeps your changes.

comingSoon.title: Tailored Resumes
comingSoon.description: Auto-customize your resume for each job by extracting skills from the job description.

review.title: Ready to submit: {{title}} at {{company}}
review.hint: Check the application in the browser and fix any errors. Approve this form, then approve its outgoing request in the sidebar. Skipping stops the run; requests already allowed may have been sent. Edits are checked against your saved answers.

help.title: Needs your help: {{title}} at {{company}}
help.hint: The browser stays open. Fix it there if you can, and/or tell the agent what to do, then Continue. Your message is also kept for this job's later attempts.
help.messagePlaceholder: e.g. The Save and Continue button needs the terms checkbox ticked first
